pr_title: fix(codegen): fix unicode escaping in es5
pr_body:
<!-- Note: CI script will automatically rebase your PR so please do not rebase unless required -->

<!-- Thanks for submitting a pull request! Please provide enough information so that others can review your pull request. -->

**Description:**
Fixes https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/3617

Babel has the logic `if target <= ES5 && original source string contains any unicode map all non-ascii to unicode`.

It's a bit implicit as the logic is across a few plugins and also through the options passed to `jsesc` (that depend on target and babel version) [but here babel sets](https://github.com/babel/babel/blob/0058b7fef4d028d2826645b28e3b448517cd979d/packages/babel-plugin-transform-literals/src/index.ts#L19.) `node.extra = undefined` if there's any unicode in string literal

[And here if](https://github.com/babel/babel/blob/df27d542ef3871c342b085e41206d21a86673c1d/packages/babel-generator/src/generators/types.ts#L204) `node.extra` exists it will return the string and otherwise process it with `jsesc` 

- I've replicated this logic in this PR.
- I've also added the logic for converting unicode characters `> 0xFFFF` to surrogate pairs to support ES5.
- I've updated the TSC test suite to match TSC and assert against unicode code points instead of characters

issue_context.title: Improper unescaping of Unicode (ES5 and below)
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

I have confirmed that the problem of improper unescaping of Unicode has been resolved in the following issue.
https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/1187

However, there is still a problem with improper unescaping when target is a string of ES5 or lower.


### Input code

```typescript
// a string of all valid unicode whitespaces
module.exports = '\u0009\u000A\u000B\u000C\u000D\u0020\u00A0\u1680\u2000\u2001\u2002' +
  '\u2003\u2004\u2005\u2006\u2007\u2008\u2009\u200A\u202F\u205F\u3000\u2028\u2029\uFEFF';
```


### Config

```json
{
    "jsc": {
        "target": "es5"
    }
}
```


### Playground link

_No response_

### Expected behavior

```
// a string of all valid unicode whitespaces
module.exports = '\u0009\u000A\u000B\u000C\u000D\u0020\u00A0\u1680\u2000\u2001\u2002' + '\u2003\u2004\u2005\u2006\u2007\u2008\u2009\u200A\u202F\u205F\u3000\u2028\u2029\uFEFF';
```

### Actual behavior

```
// a string of all valid unicode whitespaces
module.exports = '\t\n\v\f\r \xa0    ' + '          　\u2028\u2029﻿';
```

### Version

1.2.141

### Additional context

_No response_
